newsitem.title: USA: Robotics x2 adopted widely by IBM Global.
newsitem.headline: Robotics x2 adopted widely by IBM Global.

text.p: The IBM Global Services unit of International Business Machines Corp has implemented U.S. Robotics Corp's x2 technology at more than 500 North American locations and one in Japan, the firms said.
The implementation marks the largest deployment of x2 Internet and intranet services to date by a single Internet service provider, said IBM and Robotics.
The technology allows data from the Internet or intranets to be downloaded much faster than with standard V.34 modems.
With $22.9 billion in revenue in 1996, IBM Global Services is the world's largest provider of information technology, the companies said.
U.S. Robotics makes remote access servers, local area network switching equipment, desktop/mobile client products and modems, telephony products and handheld organizers.
